title: Optery Ranked Number 47 Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™
summary: Optery ranks No. 47 on the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, with 1,906% revenue growth driven by rising demand for personal data removal technology.
body_markdown:
***Attributes 1,906% Revenue Growth to Growing Demand for Personal Data Removal Technology That Finds More, Removes More, and Proves It***


Optery today announced that it ranked number 47 on the[Deloitte Technology Fast 500™](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/services/deloitte-private/articles/fast-500-awards.html) , a ranking of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America, now in its 32nd year. Optery grew 1,906% during 2022 to 2025.


Optery’s CEO and founder, Lawrence Gentilello, credits growing demand for effective personal data removal and the company’s investment in proprietary discovery and removal technology with its 1,906% revenue growth.


“Exposed personal data gives attackers the information they need to target people with social engineering, fraud, and physical threats,” said Gentilello. “Our growth reflects the need to address that exposure, both for individuals and across workforces. We built Optery to find more exposed information, remove it more comprehensively, and give customers evidence that the work is being done. This recognition from Deloitte is an honor and a reflection of the trust our customers place in our team and technology.”


“The 2026 rankings demonstrate that established momentum and breakthrough growth can drive sustained market leadership,” said Justin Yahr, Audit & Assurance partner and National Emerging Growth Company leader, Deloitte & Touche LLP. “Nearly 70% of this year’s award winners returned as repeat honorees, reflecting the power of disciplined and sustained execution. More than 30% made the list for the first time, illustrating how quickly new players are shaping their respective sectors. Furthermore, private companies represented almost 80% of the list, a clear indication that the agility and strategic focus of private enterprises remain essential to scaling in competitive markets.”


Optery’s growth comes as exposed personal data has become a core security concern for consumers and organizations. The company is unique among personal data removal solutions, combining patented search technology, sophisticated opt-out automation, and expert Privacy Agents to find and remove more exposed data broker profiles per person than other services. It is also the only service that provides before-and-after screenshots at scale to prove its effectiveness. Optery supports automated removals from 625+ sites and more than 940 sites through Custom Removals.


[Optery for Business](https://www.optery.com/business/) serves enterprises by removing personal information from the internet for their employees and executives, and offers an API that enables other companies to embed data broker scanning and removal technology into their own applications. Enterprise capabilities include real-time reporting, an API, MCP, and webhooks, and Optery is SOC 2 Type II attested.


CNET named Optery its 2026 Editors’ Choice and Best Overall Data Removal Service; Optery was the #1 most effective personal data removal service tested at the conclusion of a 4-month study by Consumer Reports, and PCMag has named Optery an Editors’ Choice for personal data removal for five consecutive years.


The Deloitte recognition follows Optery’s No. 177 placement on the 2026 Inc. 5000, including No. 2 in the Security category.


Optery’s technology and growth have been widely recognized across the technology and cybersecurity industries. Business Insider named Optery one of the 30 early-stage startups in 2025 most likely to become tech’s next unicorns.


Optery has received numerous industry awards, including:


- PCMag Editors’ Choice for personal data removal (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
- CNET Editors’ Choice and Best Overall Data Removal Service (2026)
- Cyber Defense Magazine Top InfoSec Innovators Award for Transformational Anti-Phishing (2026)
- Cyber Defense Magazine Market Disruptor Award in Digital Risk Protection (2026)
- Cybersecurity Excellence Awards in Human Risk Management, Anti-Phishing, Attack Surface Management (2026)
- Globee® Awards for Cybersecurity, Social Engineering Best of Category (2026)
- SiliconANGLE TechForward Award in the Digital Risk Protection Platform Category (2026)
- Evan Kirstel’s We Love Tech Award for Security/Cybersecurity, 2026
- Cyber Defense Magazine Most Innovative Anti-Phishing Award (2025)
- Fortress Cybersecurity Award for Privacy Enhancing Technologies (2025 and 2026)
- Cyber Defense Magazine Best Service for Attack Surface Management (2025)
- Cybersecurity Excellence Awards in Employee Privacy Protection, Attack Surface Management, and Digital Footprint Management (2024 and 2025)
- Cyber Defense Magazine Top InfoSec Innovator Award for Attack Surface Management (2024)
- Intellyx Digital Innovator Award, 2024
- Fast Company’s Next Big Things in Tech award for security and privacy (2023)


Overall, the 2026 Technology Fast 500 companies achieved revenue growth ranging from 97% to 66,330% over the three-year time frame, with an average growth rate of 1,134%.
